# PickMyClass

> Free ASU class seat tracker and open-seat email notification app for Arizona State University students.

PickMyClass helps ASU students stop manually refreshing My ASU and ASU Class Search. Students add class sections they care about, and PickMyClass checks ASU class seat availability every 30 minutes, then emails them when seats open or when an instructor changes from Staff.

## Product Facts

- Free for ASU students.
- Checks class availability every 30 minutes.
- Sends email alerts when seats open.
- Supports all ASU campuses and online classes represented in ASU Class Search.
- Not affiliated with Arizona State University.
- Source: https://github.com/Divkix/pickmyclass
